िराथयुक्॥२॥ 1-2. BENEFICE & MALEFIC YOGAS: If there be a benefice in the ascendant shubha yoga is produced while a malefic therein causes Ashubha yoga. Similarly, benefices in both the 12th and the 2nd cause Shubha yoga. Malefic in both the 12th and the 2nd also cause Ashubha yoga. One born in Shubha yoga will be eloquent, charming and virtuous while his counterpart will be sensuous, will do sinful acts and will enjoy (or swallow) others' wealth.
